decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX builds directly on the firm's long-established trommel screening knowledge and an existing customer base, so the firm can interpret field feedback and keep refining it.

Mobile high-speed flail shredders sit close to the firm's core mobile comminution competence, so the firm can absorb lessons from operation and improve the line, even though no results after 2019 are observed.
The grinder draws on related comminution know-how but has only a weak web presence and overlaps with Product E, so consolidation is plausible; the related knowledge still favours keeping it for now.

The green-waste grinder serves the firm's established composting and biomass customers, and the firm's application knowledge in that segment lets it learn from results, though overlap with Product C remains a risk.

Single-shaft pre-shredders build on the firm's core shredder expertise and support its strategic move into stationary plants, so the firm is well placed to assimilate feedback and develop them further.
